- Marketplace transaction fees: $7,250
- Reseller discount (should apply): 0 (missing)

Omar (Accounting): This is a manual adjustment case. Recommend issuing credit for full fee $7,250 and tagging as partner goodwill + system bug. Approver required for >$2k. cc @Melanie
